answer: One concrete mechanism: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because plume only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, orchard is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any signal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
